newsitem.title: ITALY: Milan to issue January CPI data on Jan 21.
newsitem.headline: Milan to issue January CPI data on Jan 21.

text.p: MILAN, Jan 13 - The Italian city of Milan will publish its preliminary January consumer price index (CPI) figures on Tuesday, January 21, the city's prices office said.
The data will be released, as usual, after 1630 GMT.
Milan is one of 10 Italian cities which issue monthly preliminary CPI data. The city has a weighting of just under 20 percent on the national index.
In December, Milan posted a month-on-month CPI rise of 0.1 percent and a year-on-year rate of 2.7 percent, against a national monthly rise of 0.1 percent and annual rate of 2.6 percent.
Official January national inflation data will be announced on February 4.
